### Observed differences

- In the later window, activity A06 appears in about 29% of traces (up from about 7%) and its mean position shifts earlier (from about 0.41 to 0.28 of the trace length). [OCC001, POS001]
- Activity A10 becomes rarer: participation drops from about 10% to about 2.5%. [OCC002]
- Activities A34, A35, A36 and A37 become near-universal: A34 and A35 rise from about 61% to 100% of traces, and A36 and A37 from about 40% to 99%. [OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006]
- Routing changes: A15 now leads to A06 in about 15% of its outgoing transitions (previously almost none); A30 now leads to A34/A35 instead of A36/A37; A34 and A35 now lead to A36/A37 instead of A31. [DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]
- A06 co-occurs with A15, A16, A30, A31, A34, A35, A36 and A37 much more often, and usually appears before them. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008]
- A34, A35, A36 and A37 now co-occur with each other and with A30/A31 in almost every trace, whereas before they were often separate. [REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030]
- A06 and A16 become adjacent (lag 1) in about 98% of later cases (was about 20%). A31 now occurs much later after A30, A34 and A35 (lag 3–5 instead of lag 1–2). [LAG001, LAG005, LAG008, LAG009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a structural change in which activity A06 is inserted early in the process, followed by a block of activities A34–A37 that are now executed in nearly every case, while A31 is moved later and A10 becomes less frequent. The occurrence, routing, relational and lag indicators all point consistently to this same pattern: A06 appears before the block, A30/A34/A35 now route into A36/A37 instead of A31, and A31 is pushed to a later position. The main limitation is that the two windows could represent different case types rather than a temporal change, but the coherence across multiple independent indicators makes a sampling artefact unlikely. [OCC001, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, REL001, REL017, REL026, LAG001, LAG005, LAG008]

DIR002: A06's outgoing transitions changed dramatically: before had many targets, after mostly A16 (89.7% vs before 7.1%). Also REL001-008: A06 co-occurs with many activities (A15, A16, A30, A31, A34, A35, A36, A37) much more often, and A06 before those activities (A_before_B increased). LAG001-003: A06 and A16 lag changed: A06 before A16 at lag 1 in 98% after vs 20% before. So A06 appears to be inserted early in the process, before a block of activities.

- A10: occurrence decreased from 0.10 to 0.025 (20 to 5 traces). OCC002.

- A34, A35, A36, A37: occurrence increased dramatically. A34: 0.61 to 1.0 (122 to 200). A35: 0.61 to 1.0 (122 to 200). A36: 0.395 to 0.99 (79 to 198). A37: 0.395 to 0.99 (79 to 198). So these activities become almost always present. Also POS004-007: A34, A35, A36, A37 positions shift slightly; A36 and A37 move later (mean position increased from 0.73 to 0.77). - DIR003: A15's outgoing transitions: before mostly A16 (97%), after A16 85% and A06 14.8%. So A15 now often goes to A06. DIR004: A30's outgoing: before A35 34%, A37 21%, A34 26%, A36 17%; after A34 46%, A35 53%, no A36/A37. So A30 now goes to A34/A35 instead of A36/A37. DIR005: A34's outgoing: before A31 56%, A35 41%; after A35 45%, A36 27.5%, A37 25%, A31 0.5%. So A34 now goes to A36/A37 instead of A31. DIR006: A35's outgoing: before A34 57%, A31 42%; after A34 53%, A36 25%, A37 20%, A31 0.5%. So A35 now goes to A36/A37 instead of A31. DIR007: A43's outgoing mostly A44 (91% to 99%). DIR008: A45's outgoing mostly A46 (93% to 98%). So those are minor.

- REL: Many pairs show co-occurrence increases. Specifically, A06 with A15, A16, A30, A31, A34, A35, A36, A37: co-occurrence increases from 0.065 or 0.04 or 0.025 to 0.285 or 0.99 etc. Also A15 with A34, A35, A36, A37: co-occurrence increases from 0.61/0.395 to 1.0/0.99. A34 with A35: co-occurrence 0.605 to 1.0. A34 with A36, A37: co-occurrence 0.005 to 0.99. A35 with A36, A37: 0.005 to 0.99. A36 with A37: 0.395 to 0.99.

- LAG: A30-A31: before lag 3 96%, after lag 5 99% (so A31 now much later after A30). A30-A36: before lag 1-2, after lag 3-4. A30-A37: before lag 1-2, after lag 3-4. A34-A31: before lag 1-2, after lag 3-4. A35-A31: before lag 1-2, after lag 3-4. So A31 moves later relative to A30, A34, A35. Also A06-A16: before lag 1-4, after lag 1 98%. A15-A06: before lag 4 75%, after lag 1 38% and lag 3 11% etc. A16-A06: before lag 3 62%, after lag 2 40% and lag 4 19%.

Overall pattern: There seems to be a structural change where a new activity A06 is inserted early, and a block of activities A34, A35, A36, A37 become mandatory (or nearly so) and reordered. Also A31 moves later, and A30/A34/A35 now lead to A36/A37 instead of A31. A10 decreases.
